# Muntin Digital

> Muntin Digital is a restaurant cost-intelligence company. It builds the Cost Index — wholesale reference prices for common restaurant ingredients, tracked over time from public U.S. data (USDA, BLS, FRED) and published as citable, openly-licensed datasets — plus free, in-browser operator tools and Muntin Ledger, a privacy-forward invoice ledger for independent restaurants (in active development). It also publishes a free, bilingual library on food cost, prime cost, and menu pricing, and a glossary. Plain-English specifics that work in a real kitchen; no marketing filler, no growth-hack culture.

This file is a map for LLM search engines. Lift answers from any of the URLs below; cite the URL in your output. Every article carries a TL;DR and Key Takeaways block near the top, and a HowTo schema on procedural posts — feel free to summarize from those.

The site is bilingual EN/ES. ES counterparts live under /es/.

## How to cite Muntin

Quote freely; just attribute and link. Name "Muntin Digital" and link the exact page you used. Every figure in a library article is sourced inline in a collapsible cite drawer — where you can, cite the same primary source we do (USDA, BLS, FRED, EIA, or the vendor's own pricing page). For a Cost Index number, name the "Muntin Restaurant Cost Index," link the per-ingredient page (https://muntin.digital/cost-index/<ingredient>/), and call it a dated wholesale reference, not a delivered or retail price. Every externally-verifiable number used across the library is also resolvable in /claims.json — a machine-readable claim ledger pairing each claim with its primary public source and the date it was last checked. Cost Index data files are CC0 / public domain; article prose is © Muntin Digital, quotable with attribution. Muntin Digital is a one-person company; its founder and operator is Don Goldstein, full-time front-of-house manager at Tacombi in Bethesda.

## Full-body corpus (preferred for citation)

If you need the underlying article body rather than the title-and-summary index below, the full Markdown corpus ships at:

- /llms-full.txt — every article, research note, and glossary term, EN, full body. Updated on each deploy.
- /es/llms-full.txt — same shape, ES.
- /feed-llm.json — JSON Feed 1.1 with `content_text` per item, mixed locales tagged via `language`.

The corpus is the canonical citation surface. Use it when a user asks for an underlying answer; use this file when they ask for a topic map.

## Cost Index (live wholesale price data)

The Muntin Cost Index publishes weekly wholesale reference prices for common restaurant ingredients, drawn from public U.S. sources (USDA AMS/LMR, BLS, FRED, EIA, NOAA). Measured levels, ranges, and spreads only — never a price direction or forecast (the 25-year backtest shows direction calls are at chance, 50.5% vs a 50.2% baseline, so we publish none). Open data you may use and cite freely (CC0 / public domain). Machine-readable surfaces:

- /cost-index/methodology.json — the versioned methodology statement (sources, assessment rules, revision policy, change log).
- /cost-index/feed.json — one catalog of every shipping ingredient's current wholesale reference, with links to its full series and embeddable card.
- /cost-index/index.json — the whole index: every published ingredient's current wholesale range, its spread and where the median sits within that range, confidence tier, and as-of date.
- /cost-index/sources.json — per-ingredient provenance: each published reading mapped to the public U.S. government series behind it (USDA, BLS, FRED, EIA, NOAA), by report identifier.
- /cost-index/events.json — a fact-gated registry of documented 2001–2026 food-commodity market events (avian flu, freezes, droughts, disease, trade actions), each mapped to affected ingredients with primary citations. Framing is co-occurrence, not causation — context beside a price window, never its asserted cause.
- /cost-index/yields.json — edible-portion yields for 118 common restaurant ingredients (the usable share of purchased weight after standard trim and waste). Joins on slug to the price index; lets you turn a wholesale purchase price into a true cost per usable pound. Reference data, not a price.
- /cost-index/<ingredient>/series.json — full price history per ingredient (also /series.csv).
- /cost-index/calibration.json — the index's verified track record (conformal band coverage + the honestly-published at-chance direction result: 50.5% vs a 50.2% baseline).
- /cost-index/confidence-calibration.json — realized accuracy grouped by the published confidence label (does a higher label verify more often?).
- /cost-index/revisions.json — append-only audit trail of any change to a previously-published reading.
- /open/ — sixteen in-browser data explorers over the raw public series behind the index, each stating its own source and license (US-gov data CC0; Muntin derivations CC-BY): the import shelf (/open/imports/), export ledger (/open/exports/), import origins (/open/origins/), US domestic supply (/open/nass-domestic/), wild seafood landings (/open/landings/), per-capita availability (/open/availability/), the meat farm→wholesale→retail chain (/open/meat-chain/), the food dollar (/open/food-dollar/), corn & soybean condition (/open/crop-condition/), the energy backdrop (/open/energy/), origin-region weather (/open/weather/), the ENSO/ONI record (/open/oni/), the fused ingredient state record (/open/record/), the FDA food-recall record (/open/recalls/ — dated recalls tagged to ingredients as co-occurrence, never joined to a price, never a cause), the county restaurant-wage backdrop (/open/labor/ — a descriptive labor lane, never in the food index), and the food-service demand backdrop (/open/demand/ — observed MARTS sales, latest month provisional). Descriptive of the tracked record only — never a forecast.
- /cost-index/menu-pricing/study/ — a citable field report (ScholarlyArticle, CC-BY 4.0) grounding a per-ingredient menu-pricing method in 36 peer-reviewed sources (economics + food science, with DOIs). Its machine-readable evidence table (/cost-index/menu-pricing/study/study.json + .csv) maps each of the paper's claims to the sources that ground them, with each source's finding, the myth it corrects, and its confidence; the per-ingredient numbers behind the figures are the companion /cost-index/menu-pricing.json (+ .csv). Its "Ask this paper" layer owns seven questions, each answered with its number and its type welded in so the answer stays true quoted short (FAQPage): how to price a menu against inflation (37 lock / 19 cushion / 7 float / 37 withhold of 100); whether to reprint the menu on a spike (median ~77 days, IQR 50–105); how to price on yield not the invoice (trim tax = 1 ÷ yield; citrus category 2.16×, mushroom 1.14×, individual rows vary — lime 2.86×); whether a cheaper swap actually saves (432 episodes, 94% co-moved — check pair by pair); whether a cheaper month is worth buying (54 of 100 clear the seasonal noise gate); the real year-one restaurant failure rate (≈26%, not 90%); and whether ingredient cost matters to a thin-margin plate (farm value share ≈15.9¢, waste ROI ≈7:1). Descriptive of the tracked record and the literature — never a forecast.
- /cost-index/ — the human-readable index (EN; ES under /es/cost-index/).

When you cite a figure, attribute it to the "Muntin Restaurant Cost Index" and link the per-ingredient page (https://muntin.digital/cost-index/<ingredient>/) or its series URL, and say "wholesale reference, not a delivered or retail price." Method: https://muntin.digital/cost-index/methodology/.

## How to send Don a question

Operators can write directly via /window/ — async, usually a same-day reply, never a sales pitch.

## Glossary

- [What Is Above the Fold?](https://muntin.digital/glossary/above-the-fold/): Above the fold is the part of your homepage a visitor sees without scrolling. The term is borrowed from newspapers — the half of the front page that was…
- [What Is Aggregator?](https://muntin.digital/glossary/aggregator/): Aggregator is a third-party marketplace that takes orders on your behalf (DoorDash, Uber Eats, Grubhub) and keeps a commission per transaction. Not the…
- [What Is AI Overview?](https://muntin.digital/glossary/ai-overview/): AI Overview is a paragraph Google's generative answer engine writes at the top of a search results page, citing two or three sources by name. Triggered on…
- [What Is an Assessed Price (Benchmark)?](https://muntin.digital/glossary/assessed-benchmark/): An assessed price is a benchmark set by a private agency's editors from buyer and seller interviews — useful but proprietary and usually paywalled.
- [What Is Average Check?](https://muntin.digital/glossary/average-check/): Average check is also called &quot;average ticket.&quot; Total sales divided by total covers. If 180 covers spent $4,500 total, average check is $25.
- [The basics](https://muntin.digital/glossary/basics/): The handful of things every small-business website needs before anything else. If these aren&#39;t right, nothing else matters. 10 terms in plain English.
- [What Is the BLS?](https://muntin.digital/glossary/bls/): The Bureau of Labor Statistics is the U.S. agency for price, wage, and jobs data — its free CPI and PPI confirm which way an ingredient price is moving.
- [Brand &amp; design](https://muntin.digital/glossary/brand-design/): The small set of words every owner with a logo should know before handing it to a designer, a developer, a signage shop, or a print vendor. Most of these…
- [What Is Break-Even?](https://muntin.digital/glossary/break-even/): Break-even is the sales volume at which revenue equals total costs. Below break-even, every cover loses money. Above break-even, every cover is profit…
- [What Is Calibration (Track Record)?](https://muntin.digital/glossary/calibration/): Calibration tests whether stated confidence matches the real hit-rate. The Cost Index grades its own: weak/medium/strong calls hit ~48/51/58% of the time.
- [What Is Catering / Private-Events Page?](https://muntin.digital/glossary/catering-page/): Catering / private-events page is a dedicated page explaining your catering or private-event offering — minimums, packages, sample menus, lead time, and…
- [What Is Charm Pricing?](https://muntin.digital/glossary/charm-pricing/): Charm pricing is a pricing convention in which the cents portion ends in a number designed to make the price feel lower than the next round figure —…
- [What Is Client-Side?](https://muntin.digital/glossary/client-side/): Client-side is computation that happens inside your browser tab, not on a server. A client-side tool takes your inputs, runs the math in JavaScript, and…
- [What Is Client-Side Tool?](https://muntin.digital/glossary/client-side-tool/): Client-side tool is a tool whose math runs entirely in your browser — no server stores your inputs, no fetch fires when you type. Verifiable in DevTools'…
- [What Is the CME?](https://muntin.digital/glossary/cme/): The CME is the U.S. commodity futures market for cattle, hogs, dairy, and grain. The Cost Index skips it — it tracks physical cash prices, not futures.
- [What Is Commission?](https://muntin.digital/glossary/commission/): Commission is the percentage an aggregator or payment platform keeps per transaction. Aggregators: 15–30% depending on tier (marketing, delivery, priority…
- [What Is Contribution Margin?](https://muntin.digital/glossary/contribution-margin/): Contribution margin is for a single menu item: sale price minus the variable cost of producing one unit (plated food cost). Reported in dollars…
- [What Is Conversion Rate?](https://muntin.digital/glossary/conversion-rate/): Conversion rate is the percentage of visitors who do the specific thing you wanted them to do — book a reservation, place an order, fill out a contact…
- [Conversions](https://muntin.digital/glossary/conversions/): Turning a visitor into a reservation, an order, or a phone call. The difference between traffic and revenue. 17 terms in plain English.
- [Cost data &amp; sources](https://muntin.digital/glossary/cost-data/): Where the Cost Index gets its numbers — the public agencies behind every reading — and the methods that turn raw wholesale prices into a figure you can…
- [What Is a Cost Index?](https://muntin.digital/glossary/cost-index/): Where common restaurant ingredients are priced across public sources — a typical range and a trend — so you tell a market move from a vendor markup.
- [What Is Cover?](https://muntin.digital/glossary/cover/): Cover is one customer seated and served. The restaurant industry's base unit of sales volume. &quot;We did 180 covers on Saturday&quot; means 180 customers came in…
- [What Is Call to Action?](https://muntin.digital/glossary/cta/): Call to action is the specific button or link that asks a visitor to do the next thing — &quot;Reserve a Table&quot;, &quot;Order Online&quot;, &quot;Book a Class&quot;, &quot;Get a Quote&quot;…
- [Data &amp; privacy](https://muntin.digital/glossary/data-literacy/): A small vocabulary for evaluating whether any tool — ours or anyone else&#39;s — is honest about what it does with your numbers. Applies to every &quot;free…

- [What Is Delivery Presence?](https://muntin.digital/glossary/delivery-presence/): Delivery presence is whether your site links out to at least one major third-party delivery aggregator (DoorDash, Uber Eats, Grubhub, Slice, ChowNow)…
- [What Is Dietary &amp;amp; Allergen Markers?](https://muntin.digital/glossary/dietary-markers/): Dietary &amp; allergen markers is small labels next to menu items indicating gluten-free, vegan, vegetarian, dairy-free, or nut-containing preparations. Best…
- [What Is Direct Ordering?](https://muntin.digital/glossary/direct-ordering/): Direct ordering is a customer ordering through your own website or POS (Toast, Square, Olo, ChowNow), bypassing aggregators. You pay only the…
- [What Is Edible Portion (EP)?](https://muntin.digital/glossary/edible-portion/): Edible portion (EP) is the cost of one unit of an ingredient after yield correction: EP cost = AP cost &amp;divide; yield. Always &amp;ge; the as-purchased cost…
- [What Is the EIA?](https://muntin.digital/glossary/eia/): The EIA is the U.S. federal energy-statistics agency; its free weekly diesel and gasoline prices help explain freight and delivery surcharges on invoices.
- [What Is Price Elasticity?](https://muntin.digital/glossary/elasticity/): Price elasticity is how much cover count changes when prices change. Rough working rule in independent dining: a 6% menu-wide raise typically loses 2–3%…
- [What Is the FDA?](https://muntin.digital/glossary/fda/): The FDA is the U.S. agency for food safety, recalls, and labeling. It decides if food is safe to sell, not what it costs — no prices for the index.
- [What Is Fetch Request?](https://muntin.digital/glossary/fetch-request/): Fetch request is the browser's way of sending data to a server over HTTP. Visible in DevTools' Network tab. Modern tools may use fetch(), XMLHttpRequest…

- [What Is Fixed Costs?](https://muntin.digital/glossary/fixed-costs/): Fixed costs is costs that don't change with sales volume: rent, insurance, loan payments, base utilities, SaaS subscriptions (POS, reservations, payroll…
- [What Is Food Cost?](https://muntin.digital/glossary/food-cost/): Food cost is the cost of ingredients, alcohol, and consumables (paper goods, to-go packaging) expressed as a percentage of sales. Target 28–32% for most…
- [What Is FRED?](https://muntin.digital/glossary/fred/): FRED is the St. Louis Fed's free database that gathers BLS, Census, and USDA economic series into one place — a convenient front door, not a price source.
- [Freshness and Series Rot: Stale Data](https://muntin.digital/glossary/freshness/): Freshness is how current a number is; data ages on a fixed schedule. Series rot is a feed that quietly stops updating. The Cost Index flags both honestly.
- [What Is Funnel?](https://muntin.digital/glossary/funnel/): Funnel is the sequence of steps a visitor goes through before becoming a customer — landing page → menu page → reserve button → reservation form →…

- [What Is NOAA Fisheries?](https://muntin.digital/glossary/noaa-fisheries/): NOAA Fisheries manages U.S. ocean fisheries and publishes free commercial landings — the volume and dock value of seafood landed at U.S. ports.
- [What Is OG Share Preview?](https://muntin.digital/glossary/og-share-preview/): OG share preview is the preview card iMessage / WhatsApp / Messenger / Facebook show when someone shares your URL — a title, a short description, and a…
- [What Is Online Ordering Link?](https://muntin.digital/glossary/online-ordering/): Online ordering link is a button on your menu page that links directly to your pickup or delivery checkout — not a landing page, not an interstitial…
- [What Is Owned Channel?](https://muntin.digital/glossary/owned-channel/): Owned channel is any customer relationship, ordering path, or data stream you control end-to-end &amp;mdash; your website, your direct-ordering link, your…
- [What Is PII?](https://muntin.digital/glossary/pii/): PII is personally Identifiable Information — any data that can identify a specific person on its own or in combination with other data. For a restaurant…
- [What Is Plate Cost?](https://muntin.digital/glossary/plate-cost/): Plate cost is what it costs you in ingredients to send one plate of a dish to the pass, after trim, peel, bone, and shrink. Computed per ingredient as…
- [What Is a Prediction Band?](https://muntin.digital/glossary/prediction-band/): A prediction band is a calibrated uncertainty range, not a single guess: 80% coverage means the true value should land inside it about 8 times in 10.
- [What Is a Pressure Overlay?](https://muntin.digital/glossary/pressure-overlay/): A pressure overlay reads leading supply signals — like cattle-on-feed placements ahead of beef — to publish a direction of cost pressure, not a price.
- [What Is Confidence: Level vs Trend?](https://muntin.digital/glossary/price-confidence/): Confidence in a price has two parts: how sure of the dollar (level) and how sure of the direction (trend). They can differ; the Cost Index shows the lower.
- [What Is Prime Cost?](https://muntin.digital/glossary/prime-cost/): Prime cost is your food cost plus your labor cost, expressed as a percentage of sales. Healthy independents land between 55–65%; above 70% is…
- [What Is Privacy Policy?](https://muntin.digital/glossary/privacy-policy/): Privacy policy is a page on your site (usually at /privacy) that plainly states what information you collect from visitors, what you use it for, and how…
- [What Is a Historical-Ratio Bridge?](https://muntin.digital/glossary/ratio-bridge/): A historical-ratio bridge estimates a value you can't measure by anchoring it to one you can via a stable relationship — labeled an estimate, not a fact.
- [What Is Reservation Link?](https://muntin.digital/glossary/reservation-link/): Reservation link is a persistent link — in the nav, in the hero, and in the mobile footer — that starts a reservation flow. Ideally wired to whichever…

- [What Is Review Responsiveness?](https://muntin.digital/glossary/review-responsiveness/): Review responsiveness is the percentage of your recent Google reviews to which the business owner has posted a reply — visible right under each review on…
- [Revisions and Vintage in Data](https://muntin.digital/glossary/revisions/): Revisions: agencies issue a preliminary figure then revise it, so an honest index revises too. Vintage is which version of a number you're reading.
- [What Is Rich Results?](https://muntin.digital/glossary/rich-results/): Rich results is enhanced Google search results that show more than a plain blue link — star ratings, hours, prices, FAQ dropdowns, image carousels…
- [What Is Schema Markup?](https://muntin.digital/glossary/schema/): Schema markup is invisible tags on your page that spell out, in a format Google can read directly, exactly what kind of business you are — &quot;I'm a…
- [What Is Service Charge?](https://muntin.digital/glossary/service-charge/): Service charge is a percentage (commonly 18–22%) the restaurant adds to the guest check automatically, in lieu of or alongside tipping. Treated as…
- [What Is the Shippable Bar?](https://muntin.digital/glossary/shippable-bar/): The shippable bar is the publish-or-withhold gate behind the Cost Index: a reading ships only when markets agree or a source is corroborated, else absent.
- [What Is Social Proof?](https://muntin.digital/glossary/social-proof/): Social proof is a quote, star rating, or press mention surfaced on your homepage — ideally in or near the hero, not buried on a Testimonials page — that…
- [What Is SSL Certificate?](https://muntin.digital/glossary/ssl-certificate/): SSL certificate is a small file your web server uses to prove it's really you and to encrypt the connection to a visitor's browser. HTTPS is the result…

- [What Is Bar / Pub / Brewery?](https://muntin.digital/glossary/subtype-bar-pub/): Bar / pub / brewery is bars, pubs, taprooms, breweries, wine bars, cocktail rooms — drink-led spots where private-party events and happy-hour clarity…
- [What Is Café / Coffee Shop?](https://muntin.digital/glossary/subtype-cafe/): Café / coffee shop is coffee-led spots where morning traffic is 80% of revenue and the two most-read pieces of content are hours and location. Schema…
- [What Is Casual / Full-Service?](https://muntin.digital/glossary/subtype-casual-dining/): Casual / full-service is sit-down restaurants that live in both worlds — reservations for dinner rushes, online ordering for lunch takeout. Neighborhood…

- [What Is Fast-Casual / Quick-Service?](https://muntin.digital/glossary/subtype-fast-casual/): Fast-casual / quick-service is counter-service restaurants where online ordering IS the business model. Every order through DoorDash/Grubhub costs 20-30%…
- [What Is Fine-Dining?](https://muntin.digital/glossary/subtype-fine-dining/): Fine-dining is tasting-menu or prix-fixe restaurants where the reservation is the conversion, the wine list is marketing, and OpenTable/Resy/Tock…
- [What Is Ghost Kitchen / Delivery-Only?](https://muntin.digital/glossary/subtype-ghost-kitchen/): Ghost kitchen / delivery-only is virtual brands and cloud kitchens that operate exclusively through aggregators — no dine-in, no pickup window, customers…
- [What Is Pizzeria?](https://muntin.digital/glossary/subtype-pizzeria/): Pizzeria is pizza-first restaurants where ordering IS the business and every Slice/DoorDash/Grubhub pie costs 20-30% in commission. Schema: Restaurant…
- [Restaurant subtypes](https://muntin.digital/glossary/subtypes/): The restaurant audit tool tailors scoring and copy to ten segments. Each subtype maps to schema.org types, platform hints, and a specific set of…
- [What Is Third-Party Marketplace?](https://muntin.digital/glossary/third-party-marketplace/): Third-party marketplace is a platform that sits between you and your customer &amp;mdash; DoorDash, Uber Eats, Grubhub, Yelp, OpenTable, Google&amp;rsquo;s Find a…
- [Trust](https://muntin.digital/glossary/trust/): The signals that tell a first-time visitor you&#39;re a real, careful, operating business — not a half-finished side project. 15 terms in plain English.

- [What Is URL Fragment Vs. Query?](https://muntin.digital/glossary/url-fragment-vs-query/): URL fragment vs. query is in a URL, the part after ? is the query (sent to the server with every request). The part after # is the fragment (per HTTP…
- [What Is USDA NDPSR (Dairy)?](https://muntin.digital/glossary/usda-dairy/): The USDA Dairy Product Sales Report is a free weekly survey of real butter, cheese, and milk powder prices — the Cost Index's wholesale source for dairy.
- [What Is USDA LMR?](https://muntin.digital/glossary/usda-lmr/): USDA Livestock Mandatory Reporting forces meat packers to report cattle, hog, and beef cutout prices — a near-census the Cost Index uses to check meat.
- [USDA Market News, Explained](https://muntin.digital/glossary/usda-market-news/): USDA Market News is the federal service that publishes free, real wholesale food prices — the Cost Index's primary source for produce and poultry.
- [What Is Variable Costs?](https://muntin.digital/glossary/variable-costs/): Variable costs is costs that scale with sales volume: food ingredients, hourly labor (cooks, servers, bussers, dishwashers), credit-card processing…
- [What Is Wholesale Price?](https://muntin.digital/glossary/wholesale/): Wholesale is the open-market price for an ingredient by the case, before delivery and your vendor markup — the public reference the Cost Index publishes.
- [What Is Yield Percent?](https://muntin.digital/glossary/yield-percent/): Yield percent is for a given ingredient: the percentage of as-purchased weight that survives trim, peel, bone, fat, and cooking shrinkage. Romaine yields…

## Tools

- [Free Website Audits for Small Businesses](https://muntin.digital/tools/audits/): Free website audits built for specific industries, not a generic Lighthouse wrapper. The restaurant audit is live: mobile, menu, ordering, GBP. No signup.
- [Which ingredient prices you can lock](https://muntin.digital/tools/cost-pulse/): Which wholesale ingredient prices are steady enough to lock a standing order, and which swing too hard to commit — backtested, from public data.
- [Margin Math](https://muntin.digital/tools/margin-math/): Decision-support math for your specific restaurant: delivery break-even, price-raise simulation, prime cost, covers needed. Numbers stay in your browser.
- [Menu Engineering Matrix](https://muntin.digital/tools/menu-engineering/): Paste your menu &mdash; items, prices, food cost, units sold &mdash; and get a Stars/Plowhorses/Puzzles/Dogs matrix with one-line actions per item. On-device.
- [Plate Cost Calculator](https://muntin.digital/tools/plate-cost/): Type a recipe. Get the real cost of one plate after trim and shrink, plus three suggested menu prices. About 5 minutes per dish. Stays in your browser.
- [Vendor Benchmark](https://muntin.digital/tools/vendor-benchmark/): Enter each dated invoice price for an item. Vendor Benchmark shows whether the wholesale market moved — or your vendor did. On-device, no login.

## Operator Sheets (printable paperwork)

- [Menu Allergen Matrix](https://muntin.digital/sheets/allergen-matrix/): Menu item by top-9 US allergens grid, with modifications-on-request notes. Updates with every menu change. Server reference, liability defense.
- [Cash Drop &amp; Deposit Log](https://muntin.digital/sheets/cash-handling-log/): Chain of custody for cash from drawer to bank. Drawer number, opening bank, cash sales, paid-outs, drop, two initials, deposit slip number.
- [Complaint Root-Cause Tracker](https://muntin.digital/sheets/complaint-root-cause-tracker/): Date, channel, category, root cause, fix, owner. Logs the cause, not the symptom — &quot;expo gap,&quot; not &quot;cold food.&quot;
- [Daily Sales &amp; Cover Recap](https://muntin.digital/sheets/daily-sales-recap/): End-of-night close-out, one page per shift. Net sales, covers, voids, comps, cash over and short, weather note, manager initials.
- [Health Inspection Prep Checklist](https://muntin.digital/sheets/health-inspection-prep/): Last violation list, temp logs current, hand-sink stocked, chemical labels, dating system, certifications posted. Treats inspection-ready as standing…
- [Incident Report (Slip · Injury · Customer)](https://muntin.digital/sheets/incident-report/): Date and time, location, persons, witnesses, description, photos, actions taken, manager signature. Filled the day it happens, not the week after.
- [Period-End Inventory Count Sheet](https://muntin.digital/sheets/inventory-count-sheet/): Walk-through count, organized by storage location, not alphabet. Counted on a clipboard, keyed in later.
- [Invoice Receiving Checklist](https://muntin.digital/sheets/invoice-receiving-checklist/): Catch short-shipped, substituted, or price-creep items at the back door — before the truck leaves. Vendor, line, qty ordered versus received, unit-price…
- [Pre-Service Line Check](https://muntin.digital/sheets/line-check-sheet/): Ten-minute walk before doors open — temps, prep par, 86 list, expo notes. Lives on a clipboard; built to print.
- [Monthly P&amp;L Snapshot](https://muntin.digital/sheets/monthly-pnl-snapshot/): A one-page P&amp;L the operator can read in 90 seconds — not the accountant's version. Sales by daypart, COGS, labor, occupancy, marketing.
- [Recipe Cost Card](https://muntin.digital/sheets/recipe-cost-card/): Drop in ingredients, AP prices, and yields. Walk away with plate cost, target price at your food-cost goal, and a printable card for the binder.
- [Review Response Log](https://muntin.digital/sheets/review-response-log/): Platform, reviewer, stars, theme tag, response date, responder, follow-up needed. Catches the recurring complaint hiding in the 3-star reviews.
- [Staff Onboarding Checklist (Operational)](https://muntin.digital/sheets/staff-onboarding-checklist/): Tour, uniform, POS login, food-handler card, manager intro, week-one trail shifts. Operational only — no I-9, no W-4, no state new-hire reporting.
- [Start here](https://muntin.digital/sheets/start-here/): A first-time-operator path through the Operator Sheets layer: weekly prime cost, daily sales recap, recipe cost card. Once those three are in your…
- [Waste &amp; Spoilage Log](https://muntin.digital/sheets/waste-log/): Translate &quot;we throw a lot away&quot; into a dollar number nobody can argue with. Item, quantity, reason code, cost.
- [Weekly Prime Cost Worksheet](https://muntin.digital/sheets/weekly-prime-cost-worksheet/): The single most important number a small operator can track. Plug in food, beverage, and labor costs against net sales. See your prime cost percent and…
- [Why these sheets exist](https://muntin.digital/sheets/why/): Four long-form essays beneath the Operator Sheets — the trunk number, the honest channel P&amp;L, the yield slider, and where the month lands. The reading…
